name: Platinum Vape Disposable | Candy Crush'd
description:
Sweet. Smooth. Addictively good.

Candy Crush’d delivers a sugar-rush swirl of cotton candy, tropical fruit, and creamy berry that hits your taste buds like your favorite throwback treat. This balanced hybrid distillate keeps your energy light and your mood lifted — the perfect mix of fun and chill.

Built with Platinum’s clean distillate formula and dual-coil airflow design, every puff drops bold flavor, dense clouds, and zero harshness. Twice the grams means twice the satisfaction.

Flavor Profile: Cotton Candy • Tropical Fruit • Creamy Berry

Effect: Happy • Uplifted • Relaxed

Device: Rechargeable 2G Distillate Disposable • All-In-One • Smooth Draw Design
